Your webcam probably works. Some get more.

Camdeck talks to the camera over the standard USB video protocol, so any USB webcam gets the basics. Cameras with a profile also get the maker's own controls, without the maker's app.

Every USB webcam

Whatever the camera supports from this list. Logitech, Elgato, Razer and Anker included.

  • Brightness
  • Contrast
  • Saturation
  • Sharpness
  • White balance
  • Exposure
  • Backlight
  • Flicker
  • Zoom
  • Pan and tilt
  • Focus

Next up: OBSBOT Tiny 2, Tiny SE, Meet; Opal Tadpole, C1.

Not listed? Report your camera.

Plug it in, open Camdeck and choose Help → Report Your Camera… It copies a list of the controls your camera has and opens a short form to paste it into. That is enough to add most cameras without owning one.

Open the camera form

Working from the source? The same report comes from the command line, and the profile format is plain JSON.

swift run uvcctl report
